svg.text: LEVEL 6 · INDOOR PLAYGROUND · NEW LAYOUT, DRAFT
The Big Frame is the map now: 47% of the floor and up to ten floors high, with Home Base in the middle of it. The arcade is gone.
Net fences and padded posts: the frame
Lane the Counter can walk; none runs straight
Net bridge on an upper floor
Tube or open slide, one colour each
Ball Ocean: almost empty, a few loose balls
100 studs: about 6 seconds at a walk, 4 at a sprint
north is up · one net square = 12 studs
